name: Organisation 43
definition: Organised structure that is set up for a particular purpose. For example, a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution.

FullLegalName.name: Full Legal Name
FullLegalName.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

TradingName.name: Trading Name
TradingName.definition: Name used by a business for commercial purposes, although its registered legal name, used for contracts and other formal situations, may be another.

EstablishedDate.name: Established Date
EstablishedDate.definition: Date of establishment or date of founding of an institution is the date on which that institution chooses to claim as its starting point.

RegistrationCountry.name: Registration Country
RegistrationCountry.definition: Country in which the organisation is registered.

RegistrationDate.name: Registration Date
RegistrationDate.definition: Date a given organisation was officially registered.

TaxationCountry.name: Taxation Country
TaxationCountry.definition: Country of taxation of an individual person or an organisation.

CountryOfOperation.name: Country Of Operation
CountryOfOperation.definition: Country in which the organisation has its business activity.

BoardResolutionIndicator.name: Board Resolution Indicator
BoardResolutionIndicator.definition: Indicates that the new bank holds a copy of a registered company’s board resolution for the account switch.

BusinessAddress.name: Business Address
BusinessAddress.definition: Address where the business activity is taking place.

OperationalAddress.name: Operational Address
OperationalAddress.definition: Address, for example, of a shared services centre.

LegalAddress.name: Legal Address
LegalAddress.definition: Address where the entity resides and is registered. More generically, it is the home address (residential address).

RepresentativeOfficer.name: Representative Officer
RepresentativeOfficer.definition: Person in the customer's organisation who can be contacted by the account servicer.

TreasuryManager.name: Treasury Manager
TreasuryManager.definition: Person responsible of the treasury department within an organisation.

MainMandateHolder.name: Main Mandate Holder
MainMandateHolder.definition: Person who will delegate some authority to other individuals (mandate holders) to perform some specific bank operations on the account.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Sender of a message related to the life cycle of an account.
